findings.evidenceJa: おそらく、あと数日も保つまい
findings.governingReading: Shirou recalls the priest’s prognosis that Sakura probably will not last even a few more days.
findings.explanation: The English leaves the entire remembered prognosis blank.

findings.highlight: she should save her energy for emergencies
findings.evidenceJa: いざという時にライダーが戦えなくなる
findings.governingReading: Materializing Rider risks leaving Rider unable to fight when an emergency comes.
findings.explanation: The English changes a dangerous future loss of combat capacity into Sakura intentionally conserving energy.

findings.highlight: We can’t help her if we die
findings.evidenceJa: わたしたちが倒れたら、それこそ桜は助からない
findings.governingReading: If Rin and Shirou are defeated, Sakura certainly cannot be saved.
findings.explanation: The English promotes defeat into death and weakens Sakura’s objective rescue into their ability to help.

findings.evidenceJa: 無関係な人間
findings.governingReading: Rin invokes people uninvolved in the Holy Grail War.
findings.explanation: The English changes the factual boundary of involvement into a moral judgment of innocence.

findings.highlight: The silence tonight is quieter even than that
findings.evidenceJa: 上回る筈のない静寂を、容易く通り超していた
findings.governingReading: Tonight’s quiet easily passes beyond the silence that should have been impossible to surpass.
findings.explanation: The English removes both the ease and paradoxical limit of the new silence.

findings.evidenceJa: 郊外一歩手前の町並み
findings.governingReading: The dark streets lie just one step short of the outskirts or suburbs.
findings.explanation: The English moves the area across the boundary and into the suburbs.

findings.evidenceJa: おそらく五十軒ばかりの家々
findings.governingReading: Approximately fifty physical houses stand apparently unchanged.
findings.explanation: The English changes the observed buildings into demographic household units.

findings.evidenceJa: 百人以上は居た住人
findings.governingReading: More than one hundred residents should have been present.
findings.explanation: The English overstates a lower bound above one hundred as multiple hundreds.

findings.evidenceJa: 表札を通り過ぎる
findings.governingReading: Rin passes the household nameplate as she enters.
findings.explanation: The English replaces identifying household evidence with a gate.

findings.highlight: She goes up the stairs, looks through the second floor
findings.evidenceJa: 一階を回って階段を上がり二階を調べ
findings.governingReading: Rin circles through the first floor before climbing upstairs and inspecting the second.
findings.explanation: The English omits the first-floor search.

findings.evidenceJa: 胸焼けがしそうな魔力の残滓
findings.governingReading: The remaining magical residue is dense or foul enough to induce heartburn or nausea.
findings.explanation: The English removes its oppressive bodily quality.

findings.highlight: The black afterimage is stuck everywhere
findings.evidenceJa: 黒い残像
findings.governingReading: The black afterimage clings to every surface with even its form or color still remaining.
findings.explanation: The English omits the persistent visible form encoded by the source ruby.

findings.evidenceJa: あの清潔な惨状
findings.governingReading: The black residue caused the uncannily clean devastation.
findings.explanation: The English removes the defining contradiction between cleanliness and catastrophe.

findings.evidenceJa: あってはいけない
findings.governingReading: Shirou insists that the suspected relation must not be allowed to exist.
findings.explanation: The English changes emotional and moral refusal into factual impossibility.

findings.evidenceJa: あれだけの魔力の塊
findings.governingReading: The shadow is a concentrated mass or lump of magical energy.
findings.explanation: The English reduces concentrated substance to quantity.

findings.highlight: it didn’t take anything from me
findings.evidenceJa: 奪われたものはないと思う
findings.governingReading: Shirou thinks that nothing was taken from him.
findings.explanation: The English promotes his tentative self-assessment into fact.

findings.evidenceJa: 有機物だけを残らず消化していった
findings.governingReading: The shadow passed through nonliving things and digested all organic material without remainder.
findings.explanation: The English collapses the source’s organic-material category into only what was alive.

findings.highlight: There was no time to feel any fear or pain
findings.evidenceJa: 感じる時間なんてなかったでしょう
findings.governingReading: Rin infers that the victims probably had no time to feel pain or fear.
findings.explanation: The English presents her consoling inference as direct fact.

findings.highlight: it’s like the boundary field Rider set up at school, but much stronger and instantaneous
findings.evidenceJa: 瞬間的かつ強力にした魔術みたいなもの
findings.governingReading: Rin explains it as magecraft resembling an instantaneous, intensified version of Rider’s dissolution field.
findings.explanation: The English preserves the analogy but omits that she is classifying it as magecraft-like.

findings.evidenceJa: 魔力を感知できなかった
findings.governingReading: Rin could not detect the release or presence of magical energy despite the magecraft-scale event.
findings.explanation: The English changes the undetected energy signal into undetected magic itself.

findings.evidenceJa: 満足したらしい
findings.governingReading: The vanished shadow only appears to have been satisfied by one feeding.
findings.explanation: The English promotes inferred satiation into fact.

findings.highlight: The damage has already been done
findings.evidenceJa: こうして夜の町に出たところで犠牲者は出てしまった
findings.governingReading: Victims have already been produced despite the pair coming out into the night town.
findings.explanation: The English replaces the failed relationship between patrol and casualties with generic completed damage.

findings.highlight: when the shadow or Zouken was attacking them
findings.evidenceJa: なにかしら行動に移れば気配を読み取って駆けつけ
findings.governingReading: Their strategy assumed that any move by the shadow or Zouken would reveal a presence they could rush toward.
findings.explanation: The English narrows any detectable action to an attack already directed at victims.

findings.evidenceJa: 判ってはいた事だけど
findings.governingReading: Rin says the shadow’s daily growth is something she already knew.
findings.explanation: The English weakens prior knowledge into suspicion.

findings.evidenceJa: 手をつけられない怪物になっているでしょうね
findings.governingReading: Rin predicts that at this pace it will probably be an uncontrollable monster next time.
findings.explanation: The English removes the forecast modality and states the outcome as certain.
